rt:param.name: Grad_Style
rt:param.comment: Индикатор имеет градиентную заливку - объёмный фон

rt:var.name: AckSupport
rt:var.comment: Фиктивная переменная, означающая, что данный объект поддерживает самоквитирование по функции AckMe()

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub AckMe() If Allow_Confirm && Blink_on_NACK && flag_confirm && (In_Alarm > 0) && MyAlarm Then If pv_stat != Nothing Then If pv_stat.NotAcknowledged Then pv_stat.AcknowledgeAlarm(0) End If End If If pv_fail != Nothing Then If pv_fail.NotAcknowledged Then pv_fail.AcknowledgeAlarm(0) End If End If In_Alarm = False End If End Sub

Sub BGColor () Dim STrig As Boolean NoGrad = False If pv_stat == Nothing Then ValColor = Color_ErLink NoGrad = True Exit Sub //если основная переменная не привязана, то это ошибка Else STrig = PRJSPEC.GET_Susp(pv_stat.PVId, False) If Allow_Confirm && Blink_on_NACK Then If MyAlarm && pv_stat.NotAcknowledged && !STrig Then If pv_stat.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = 1 //снятая неквитированная сигнализация Else In_Alarm = 3 //нормальная неквитированная сигнализация End If Else In_Alarm = 0 End If End If If STrig Then ValColor = Color_Remont NoGrad = True ElseIf pv_stat.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD Then ValColor = Color_Inval NoGrad = True ElseIf pv_stat.Value != 0 Then ValColor = VIS.Color(Col_ON) Else ValColor = VIS.Color(Col_OFF) End If End If If pv_fail != Nothing Then STrig = STrig || PRJSPEC.GET_Susp(pv_fail.PVId, False) If STrig Then Exit Sub ElseIf Allow_Confirm && Blink_on_NACK Then If MyAlarm && pv_fail.NotAcknowledged Then If pv_fail.AlarmType == PLS_ALARMTYP_NONE Then In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 1 //снятая неквитированная сигнализация Else In_Alarm = In_Alarm | 3 //нормальная неквитированная сигнализация End If End If End If If (pv_fail.Quality != PLS_QUAL_BAD) && (pv_fail.Value != 0) Then ValColor = VIS.Color(Col_Fail) NoGrad = True End If End If End Sub

Sub CheckUsrGr() If Alarms_ForUser Then //если надо распределять сигнализаци по пользователям MyAlarm = PRJSPEC.CheckPvOwner(PointID_status, False) If pv_fail != Nothing Then MyAlarm = MyAlarm || PRJSPEC.CheckPvOwner(PointID_fail, False) End If Else MyAlarm = True End If BGColor() End Sub
rt:model.rt:event:
Dim Th_Ht As Float Dim Th_Wdth As Float Th_Ht = _This.height Th_Wdth = _This.width
Grad_BG.width = Th_Wdth Grad_BG.height = Th_Ht body.width = Th_Wdth body.height = Th_Ht RB_border.points = "0," + CStr(Th_Ht) + " " + CStr(Th_Wdth)+ "," + CStr(Th_Ht) + " " + CStr(Th_Wdth) + ",0" LU_border.points = "0," + CStr(Th_Ht) + " 0,0 " + CStr(Th_Wdth) + ",0" InGr.x = -2.5 InGr.y = -2.5 InGr.width = Th_Wdth + 5 InGr.height = Th_Ht + 5 I_Text.x = Th_Wdth / 2 I_Text.y = Th_Ht / 2 - 2.5 '2.5 - коррекция по высоте для мелких размеров

If (PointID_status != "NULL") then pv_stat = BIN(PointID_status) Else ValColor = Color_ErLink End If If (PointID_fail != "NULL") then pv_fail = BIN(PointID_fail) End If If (pv_stat != Nothing) || (pv_fail != Nothing) Then CheckUsrGr() End If

If PointID_status == "NULL" Then ShowWarning ("Объект не привязан.", 5) ElseIf (pv_stat == nothing) Then NoLink (PointID_status) ElseIf (pv_fail == nothing) Then Call_Win("wi_BIN", PointID_status) Else Dim s As String s = PointID_status + "|" + PointID_fail Open_Win_Uni(False, "multyKKS", "Составной объект", "wi_MultyPV", s) End If

If PointID_status == "NULL" Then ShowWarning ("Объект не привязан.", 5) ElseIf (pv_stat == nothing) Then NoLink (PointID_status) ElseIf (pv_fail == nothing) Then LoadPopUpMenu(PointID_status + "|BINi|wi_BIN " + PointID_status) Else /* Dim s As String s = PointID_status + "|" + PointID_fail Open_Win_Uni(False, "multyKKS", "Составной объект", "wi_MultyPV", s) */ TmpBuffer(0) = PointID_status TmpBuffer(1) = PointID_fail TmpMnuPar = PointID_status + "|BINi|wi_BIN " + PointID_status LoadPopUpMenu(PointID_status + "|ONEi|wi_BIN " + PointID_status) End If
